confirmed_data_counts.interpretation: Mirrors double effective box counts but leave class imbalance/empty rates unchanged and add no independent scene support. Empty-label rates differ strongly by country; this is a dataset composition/annotation-density observation, not proof of missing labels.

confirmed_runtime_loss_and_augmentation.classification: utils/loss.py lines358,450-454: BCEWithLogitsLoss(reduction=none), multiplied by class_weights then summed/target_scores_sum. This weights positive and negative BCE entries, not only rare positive examples. Global cls gain=.75.
confirmed_runtime_loss_and_augmentation.weights: models/yolo/detect/train.py lines151-180: counts include the actual training labels, inverse frequency**.25 normalized to mean1. Mirroring every source equally cancels in normalization. Actual logged weights [0.644,0.989,0.740,1.340,0.753,1.260,0.854,1.420].
confirmed_runtime_loss_and_augmentation.assignment: TaskAlignedAssigner topk10, alpha=.5,beta=6 combines class score**.5 with nonnegative CIoU**6; candidates must lie insideGT. Classification confidence and spatial assignment quality are coupled, so treating localization as secondary does not remove its effect on learned scores.
confirmed_runtime_loss_and_augmentation.augmentation: Actual configured mosaic=.5, closes for last10epochs; scale=.3,translate=.05,HSV .015/.4/.3, no flips,mixup,cutmix,copy_paste. RandomPerspective filters boxes with width/height<=2px, extreme aspect ratio>=100 or retained area<=10% for detection boxes. Filter behavior is confirmed source semantics, not a measured frequency of lost training boxes.
confirmed_runtime_loss_and_augmentation.optional_augmentation: Albumentations is not installed. Its optional Blur/MedianBlur/ToGray/CLAHE defaults were read in source but must not be claimed as applied.
confirmed_runtime_loss_and_augmentation.curve_interpretation: Training loss falls while validation losses rise and native mAP drops from best epoch10 to40. This is consistent with a generalization gap, but train augmentation also changes when mosaic closes; not a controlled proof of overfitting or of any single setting's effect.

saved_candidate_score_separation_evidenc.interpretation: Many GT already have geometrically adequate low-score candidates. Raising a threshold trades away recall to suppress a large FP pool; the observed bottleneck is score/type/background separation, not a demonstrated absence of representable damage features.
saved_candidate_score_separation_evidenc.target_filter_requirement_from_typed_0_0: For R>=.7 with2623GT, retain>=1837TP, losing at most53 of1890. P>=.7 then permits<=787FP, requiring removal of>=5303/6090FP (87.1%). This is an arithmetic requirement, not an expected performance forecast. A more expressive reranker might also relabel class-agnostic candidates, so it is not limited to this fixed typed pool.

prioritized_recommendations.method: Complete bounded inference alternatives first; audit label consistency and hard-negative eligibility in parallel
prioritized_recommendations.reason: Cheap retained-candidate analysis can change ranking/NMS without training, while questionable negative labels must not be blindly mined. Preserve frozen split/annotations; document adjudications in a separate candidate data version with original/mirror propagation only after approval.

prioritized_recommendations.method: A bounded second-stage proposal/crop reranker pilot is justified after negative/rare-label review
prioritized_recommendations.reason: Low-confidence candidates offer78.5% class-agnostic localization recall at.05. Pilot needs damage-vs-background rejection plus the original eight-type prediction, not only an eight-way classifier that always calls every crop damaged. Train on train-only GT/context crops and manually screened hard-negative proposals; preserve source groups and mirror linkage. Validate full detector+reranker P/R, runtime and rare-class regressions. Achieving70 requires very strong filtering/retention and is not promised.

prioritized_recommendations.method: Targeted, manually screened train-only hard negatives before another generic epoch extension
prioritized_recommendations.reason: 628 selected-point FP are background and generic negatives already comprise32% of train originals. Prioritize confusing shadows, road joints/repair textures, painted lines and country-specific backgrounds, not more easy blank roads. Do not take label-empty images as automatically correct negatives; exclude ambiguous damage until reviewed. No validation examples are to be recycled into training.

prioritized_recommendations.method: Defer a larger detector until controlled evidence identifies a capacity/localization bottleneck
prioritized_recommendations.reason: Raw current proposals already localize94.4% ofGT at.001, while extra epochs reduce validation fitness. A larger detector may improve ranking/representation but does not repair ambiguous labels or scarce independent rare support. If later authorized, use one frozen matched run with exact same data/selection and report all eight classes, cost and error changes; no blind additional runs.

prioritized_recommendations.method: If another detector training pilot is eventually justified, isolate one change
prioritized_recommendations.reason: After label review, compare background-aware/crop supervision or reduced mosaic for tiny objects against the same starting checkpoint. Log augmented GT survival counts and preserve eight-type evaluation. Current evidence cannot attribute gains to resolution, loss weights or augmentation individually.

claim_scope: Exploratory training-only audit and validation-tuned diagnosis. No new holdout/generalization, annotation correctness, depth measurement or causal efficacy claim.
